headline: Two new skills: `convene the board` for a multi-perspective review, and `forge my advisor profile` to share your archetype.

items.prompt_template: New: I can convene a board on any decision. Say `convene the board on [subject]` and a CFO, COO, customer voice, a skeptic, and a strategy seat each weigh in from your real numbers and history — then I hand you back where they disagree, because that's where the risk hides. Say `configure my board` to change the seats.

New: say `forge my advisor profile` and I'll distill how you decide into a shareable pack a colleague can load into their own Command Room — so you can sit on their board. Or `model [name] as an advisor` to build your own read of how a colleague thinks (that one stays local to you).
